mainEntity.name: How does AI improve payroll accuracy in HR software?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI improves payroll accuracy by automatically detecting anomalies (mismatched attendance, missing inputs, double-deductions), flagging compliance gaps before run, and suggesting corrections. HROne's One AI runs pre-payroll audits that reduce post-run rework by up to 80%.

mainEntity.name: Can ChatGPT or AI replace HR teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — AI augments HR teams rather than replaces them. AI handles repetitive queries (leave balance, policy lookups, payslip generation) and pattern-finding (attrition prediction, sentiment), freeing HR for strategic work. HROne's One AI is designed as an HR co-pilot, not a replacement.

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative AI in HR creates content and decisions on demand — JDs, policy responses, performance summaries, interview questions, attrition narratives. HROne's One AI uses generative AI for policy-aware chat responses, JD generation in recruitment, and on-the-fly HR analytics.
